name: Reverse Lunge
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and place your hands on your hips or clasped lightly in front of your chest.
Step back on one foot and bend both knees until the rear knee approaches the floor.
Drive firmly through your front heel and midfoot to step your rear foot back forward to the starting stance.
Step back with the opposite leg next, alternating sides on each repetition.
tips: Keep your front foot planted and guide your knee in the same direction as your toes.
Step back along hip-width tracks instead of directly behind your front foot so you stay balanced.
